authorization: Explicit current user task for bounded 2023 Stage2 complete architecture research and Draft PR.

fixed_rules.exit_rules: Reuse the already frozen MANAGEMENT delivered-close premise/stagnation, Momentum fixed-TP removal/BE/trailing, future amendments, original max hold and session flat. Only initial Stop redesign and ATR14 entry gate disabled, because entries and original protection are deliberately held constant.
fixed_rules.isolation: Isolates exit-bundle contribution from initial Stop and new entry opportunities; does not factorially isolate every individual exit trigger.
fixed_rules.metrics: Pairs with same seed entry and original initial risk, both outcomes known. Diagnostic change in Net per instrument, winners damaged/losses reduced and exit counts. Independent overlapping seeds are not a tradable portfolio: no full Net/PF/DD/frequency claim.
fixed_rules.parameters: No changed constant, threshold or parameter sweep.
fixed_rules.scope: All2058 original accounted2023 entries independently seeded at exact original Open/time, Stop, Take and R; original82 unknown outcomes excluded unchanged.
fixed_rules.unknown: If new exit path becomes unknown, keep counterfactual Net=null and omit pair; no missing-bar study or invented prices.

rationale: Initial management bundle can widen Stop and alter opportunity flow; pure exit ablation is needed to test loss reduction versus prematurely closing future winners without attributing structural risk changes to new exits.
